# Matheus Albuquerque

> Developer, speaker, creator. Obsessed with performance and DX. Staff Software Engineer at Medallia in Prague. Google Developer Expert.

Matheus Albuquerque writes, speaks, and builds for the web. This file is a short map. Follow a link for the clean text of a page. The full catalog, including every post and talk, is [llms-full.txt](https://www.ythecombinator.space/llms-full.txt).
